question: Does the latest official S24 RAW-sRGB release provide materially new capture-time paired information with rights suitable for the automatic single-reference product or controlled named-stock mainline?

allowed: capture-time paired source qualification before payload access
private isolated noncommercial RAW and multi-render research
forbidden: opening candidate 3 of the terminated automatic single-reference cycle
treating smartphone ISP or Lightroom styles as named-film evidence
using noncommercial data or derived weights as a product dependency
downloading train, validation or test pixels before an independently frozen noncommercial protocol

edit_aware_raw.title: Edit-aware RAW reconstruction
edit_aware_raw.scientific_scope: An edit-aware sRGB rendering loss for RGB-to-RAW reconstruction using a modular differentiable ISP; not reference-style identification or named-film estimation.

time_aware_awb.title: Time-Aware Auto White Balance in Mobile Photography

material_information.known_pairing_limit: The camera-ISP sRGB image has a documented pixel shift from internal cropping; exact geometry is not established by the source README alone.

decision.interpretation: The release is a strong capture-time multi-render research source: it binds one smartphone capture to linear RAW, camera ISP output, an expert local Lightroom render, five preset renders and rich metadata. It is nevertheless a smartphone photofinishing dataset rather than named-film evidence, and the only explicit repository licence is noncommercial ShareAlike with no separate dataset licence in the dataset directory. It therefore cannot reopen candidate 3 or become a commercial product dependency.
decision.opens: At most a separately preregistered, storage-bounded, private noncommercial source/pixel preflight for RAW edit-fidelity or multi-render representation research.
decision.does_not_open: Automatic single-reference search, named-stock fitting, product weights, public package/schema/capability, or dataset redistribution.
decision.next_mainline: Continue the controlled three-stock physical evidence lane and mature RAW/DNG/HDR/portable explicit-operator engineering. Do not download this dataset unless a concrete isolated noncommercial experiment first proves it is the shortest discriminating path.
